messages:
Priya Anand: Heads-up — offer for candidate (external) for Eng Platform. Hiring manager wants an earlier start and an ad-hoc sign-on to match a competing firm. Current band max = $180k, hiring mgr proposing $192k total comp + $10k sign-on. This exceeds band. Also note: if start is before 2025-04-15 benefits kick in 2 weeks earlier, which changes the cost. Need exception routing and timeline.

Jamal Ortiz: Confirmed — candidate has a live counteroffer. They want 2025-05-12 start. Without sign-on they will walk. We recommend: base at $184k (band uplift), $10k one-time sign-on, and a $2k relocation allowance.

Aisha Chen: Thanks. Can you add cost center and org justification? Need to show incremental run-rate and one-time cost. Also flagging this will push us over H2 hiring commit by headcount if not swapped.

Jamal Ortiz: Cost center = ENG-PLAT-02. Headcount is an approved open headcount (replacing a backfilled role). Justification: critical infra hire for customer-facing latency work, high attrition risk.

Liam Park: This triggers cross-region parity rules and a comp-band exception. Per handbook, anything above band plus one-band uplift needs VP sign-off and Comp Committee review. Add comparable market data if available.

Priya Anand: Uploaded offer packet and market comp memo to the approval form (link: https://redwood-internal/offers/1759876543). Submitted initial request to offer-approvals-bot for routing.

offer-approvals-bot: Request 1759876543 received and routed to: Comp Committee, VP Eng, Finance, CFO. ETA for review: 48 hours.

Sam Kline: Can we see the P&L delta? One-time sign-on = $10k, uplifted base +$4k annual (~$4k * 1.3 burden = $5.2k). Need projected FY impact and why we can't move from existing band (e.g., relocation covered?).

Priya Anand: FY impact calc in the packet: one-time = $10k, recurring comp delta = $5.2k annual (loaded). Relocation is $2k one-time. We included recruiting notes — candidate will decline without at least the sign-on.

Aisha Chen: Finance ok to cover the one-time sign-on under candidate retention budget if Comp Committee signs off on uplift. Please confirm code/PO and I'll prep journal entries.

Jamal Ortiz: Candidate confirmed will accept if we confirm by EOD tomorrow. Hiring team will hold slot.

Liam Park: I've flagged this for Comp Committee this afternoon. Preliminary stance: strong case given market comp and criticality, but needs VP Eng sign-off and CFO concurrence.

Sam Kline: Provisionally approve the one-time sign-on and headcount impact, pending VP Eng "final approval". If VP signs off, Finance will route payment through retention budget.

Priya Anand: Thanks all — routing to VP Eng (cc: @Sam Kline) for final sign. If VP signs before EOD tomorrow we can lock start date 2025-05-12 and update benefits start. Will update thread when we have final sign-off. :pray:

Jamal Ortiz: Appreciate the quick turnaround — candidate notified we expect an answer within 48 hrs.

Priya Anand: Noted. I'll follow up with Legal if any clause tweaks needed for sign-on repayment.
